description: Unit test class for RetrieveAcl, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and instantiation from JSON in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.query package.

classes.name: RetrieveAclTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the RetrieveAcl command, performing immutability checks, equality, JSON serialization, and parsing tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the RetrieveAcl class is immutable and that its ThingId component is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods in RetrieveAcl.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveAcl instance with null string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrieveAcl instance with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: jsonSerializationWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the RetrieveAcl instance serializes correctly to JSON.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a RetrieveAcl instance can be created correctly from JSON.
